content: boxo Blockstore canonical interface: DeleteBlock, Has, Get, GetSize, Put, PutMany, AllKeysChan (+optional AllKeysChanWithErrer reporting mid-iteration truncation), optional Viewer (zero-copy View), GCLocker, HashOnRead(bool) toggles verification-on-read; base store keys by multihash only under /blocks prefix (codec lost — enumeration returns Raw codec CIDs, documented limitation); Put does Has-before-Put unless WriteThrough; composition via wrappers: ValidatingBlockstore (recompute CID on Get, ErrHashMismatch), idstore (identity CIDs), bloomcache, tqcache, gateway remoteBlockstore implements read-only subset with Put/Delete/AllKeysChan returning ErrNotImplemented — read-only stores are a legitimate pattern.
